text_block_list.text:
One day, drawn in by the signboard, 
we stepped into a Morioka jajamen noodle 
shop—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
? Might this taste a wee bit different 
from what they make back in Morioka? 
It kinda seems on the lighter side...

text_block_list.name: Jajamen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
What's that, little lady? You from 
Morioka? 
...Sorry 'bout that, especially after you 
went outta your way to come here.

text_block_list.name: Jajamen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
It's just... I've been livin' down here so 
long, see. 
I ended up forgettin' the true taste of 
Morioka.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Holy moly?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
No way... That's... that's just too sad, 
b'gosh. 
Even though you're from Morioka yourself, 
sir...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Well then—!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I will! I'm gonna help you 
remember what real Morioka jajamen tastes 
like!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Can't find it anywhere, this Morioka 
miso. 
Even when I called home, they told me 
they ain't got a clue when they could ship 
it...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Without that specific miso, I can't 
recreate 
that meat miso paste... Mmmgh...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
No, mopin' around won't do no good! 
All I can do is keep searchin' till I find 
it! 
Now then, where's the nearest grocery 
store around here...
choice_data_list:
Could we make something close with other 
ingredients?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
We might could, but... 
I don't wanna cut no corners!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
'Cause I want him to get the full, 
authentic Morioka experience!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
So I gotta keep lookin'! 
Though draggin' you along this far, 
Trainer...

If she wanted to share Morioka, it had to 
be at its best. 
As her trainer, I hadn't realized that 
until now. In that case—
choice_data_list: Let me give you my full support, too.
Let me give you my full support, too.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Golly gee?! 
...Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
We ended up ramblin' way outside of Tokyo, 
but I'm sure glad we tracked it down, 
b'gosh!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: All that's left now is to cook it up!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Right! Gotta call an acquaintance of 
mine! 
They run a real tasty jajamen shop back in 
Morioka!
choice_data_list:
Wait, are you following the authentic 
recipe to the letter?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Well, o' course! 
There's gotta be all kinds of secret 
seasoning proportions!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, on LANE... 
"Please video call me later"... and send!

text_block_list.name: Man on Video Call
text_block_list.text:
"Well now, makin' it over and over 
seems to be payin' off, wouldn't ya say?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! The flavor's pretty much perfect 
now. 
And the texture of the noodles is comin' 
along great too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Now this is what Morioka jajamen is all 
about! 
...Wait, hang on.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
The batch I just made was downright tasty, 
but the one before was real smooth and 
nice too...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It's, well, how do I put it... 
Every single one of 'em is just so darn 
good... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Well, um... I've eaten so much of it, 
I can't even tell what Morioka flavor is 
supposed to be anymore...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...A-At this rate, I won't be able to help 
that shop 
remember our hometown at all...!

Her deep love for her hometown seemed to 
have backfired; 
after countless frantic taste tests, 
she had lost track of what the right 
answer was.

Still, there was no need to worry. 
After all—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! My folks sent over some 
boiled bamboo shoots, b'gosh! 
They're so tender and mighty delicious!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
How about some of Yukino's special cold 
noodles! I tried 
recreatin' how Mama makes 'em, but what do 
ya think?

I had tasted Morioka right alongside her 
many times. 
Which meant—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh, you will, Trainer?!
choice_data_list:
Thanks to you, I know a little bit about 
Morioka's flavors now.

Thanks to you, I know a little bit about 
Morioka's flavors now.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you so much! 
I'll put my trust in your taste buds!
(Slurp, slurp...!)

text_block_list.name: Jajamen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
...Now that's good. 
Yeah, crazy good.

text_block_list.name: Jajamen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
...Aye, this was the taste. 
The jajamen I always loved.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...! Did it bring back memories, 
the true flavor of Morioka...?

text_block_list.name: Jajamen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Guess I clean forgot all this 
time. 
Even though it was this very flavor that 
made me open up shop in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Jajamen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
I can't thank ya enough! 
Next time, lunch is on me—the best bowl 
you've ever had!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait to see how his shop turns 
out! 
Wonder what his next batch of jajamen'll 
taste like!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm looking forward to it.
Yeah, I'm looking forward to it.

The noodles you made were delicious too, 
Yukino.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait to see how his shop turns 
out! 
Wonder what his next batch of jajamen'll 
taste like!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm looking forward to it.
Yeah, I'm looking forward to it.

The noodles you made were delicious too, 
Yukino.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, hehe! You've got flour on you! 
Both of our clothes are dusted in it, 
Trainer!
choice_data_list: Whoa, you're right! Let's go dust it off.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Right! Ah, but um... just a little longer. 
I'd kinda like to stay like this just a 
little while longer.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Good grief?! That much?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Eeeek...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I used to go out for jajamen all the time 
growin' up, 
and Mama made it for us a whole bunch too.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
So— 
if you were able to catch even a little 
glimpse of my past through it... 
It just, well... makes me real happy!
